title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) -> dbx 224 -> Korg MR1000 (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑row audience tape that captures a high‑energy July 28 1982 Red Rocks show with monster Shakedown Street and smoking Althea/Let It Grow performances.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the night’s relentless intensity, highlighting Jerry Garcia’s soaring solos and a string of standout numbers – from a monster “Shakedown Street” to an incendiary second‑set pairing of “Althea” and “Let It Grow.” The audience recording is praised for its vivid front‑row perspective despite occasional distortion from Jerry’s volume and clipped song intros, making it a must‑grab for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews describe an outstanding performance and a very good (near‑excellent) audience recording; minor distortion and clipping keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑row audience tape with clear instrument separation and strong stage presence; occasional distortion from Jerry’s high volume and a few clipped intros, plus rain noise from the tarp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high energy from the opening “Shakedown Street” through to the final note of “Baby Blue,” with a seamless second‑set flow highlighted by Althea > Let It Grow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ‘far out in front,’ nimble, perfect solos; volume was unusually high (3× normal) giving a powerful presence.
